mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CI_MIGRATION_HISTORY ( BATCH_ID, TOTAL_COUNT, SUCCESS_COUNT, DUPLICATE_COUNT, FAIL_COUNT, START_DT, STATUS, EXEC_BY ) VALUES ( #{batchId}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{duplicateCount}, #{failCount}, NOW(), #{status}, #{execBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CI_MIGRATION_HISTORY SET TOTAL_COUNT = #{totalCount}, SUCCESS_COUNT = #{successCount}, DUPLICATE_COUNT = #{duplicateCount}, FAIL_COUNT = #{failCount}, END_DT = NOW(), STATUS = #{status} WHERE HIST_SEQ = #{histSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT HIST_SEQ, BATCH_ID, TOTAL_COUNT, SUCCESS_COUNT, DUPLICATE_COUNT, FAIL_COUNT, START_DT, END_DT, STATUS, EXEC_BY FROM TB_CI_MIGRATION_HISTORY ORDER BY HIST_SEQ DESC LIMIT 20
